description: This file contains acceptance test cases for the AOR_Reports module in a SuiteCRM project. It defines a class with multiple test scenarios to verify viewing, creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting reports within the application. The class utilizes the Faker library for generating test data and interacts with different step classes to perform actions in the UI.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for verifying the functionality of the reports module in SuiteCRM, including viewing, creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting reports through UI interactions.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Initializes faker data generator and seeds it with a random seed before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewReportsModule
methods.description: Verifies that the reports module can be viewed from the reports list view as an admin.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateReport
methods.description: Tests creating a new report in the reports module.

methods.name: testScenarioViewReportFromListView
methods.description: Tests viewing a specific report from the list view.

methods.name: testScenarioEditReportFromDetailView
methods.description: Verifies that an existing report can be edited from its detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDuplicateReportFromDetailView
methods.description: Tests duplicating an existing report from its detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDeleteRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Ensures that a report can be deleted from its detail view.

search-terms: Create, view, edit, duplicate, delete report
